Which I find very funny. What was yours?

story_text.value:
Built a codex like harness for non-tech builders to easily clone B2B SaaS using open-weight models.

We figured companies are still charging for building software. Software, we think is commoditized. Tokens are cheap, and intelligence is open. What's the point of billing tokens.

We want to take the power back from big labs and democratize the power of SoTA LLMs for every builder out there. 1M output tokens shouldn't cost 10s of dollars.

Lots of work to be done but we built a harness that can use open weight models from open router to build SaaS clones.

Give it a shot and lmk what you guys think. We are giving away a generous free tier of open weight model credits along with a lot of SaaS templates that you can start with.

story_text.value:
We made Backplane to actually use Fable, Astra, etc. as real electrical engineers! It incorporates KiCad + your favorite harness (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Grok) to accelerate hardware development. You can use it "autonomously" or work alongside the agent, making changes or comments to redirect the agent as it works. Also has some slick skills for schematic editing, BOM management.

Hardware is in its "tab to accept changes"/copilot era rather than its agentic era imo.
